summary: A clean, enriched CSV of all ~15,000 US Medicare/Medicaid-certified skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) and nursing homes, sourced from CMS Care Compare Provider Information — publicly downloadable with no authentication required. Fields include facility name, address, ownership type (for-profit/non-profit/government), ownership organization, number of certified beds, overall 5-star rating, health inspection rating, staffing rating, quality measure rating, RN/LPN/CNA staffing hours per resident day, number of deficiencies, penalty amounts, and most recent inspection date. HealthcareData.com charges $395 for nursing home mailing lists; Definitive Healthcare charges $15,000+/year for SNF facility intelligence used by senior care SaaS vendors and healthcare PE. A $49 one-time Gumroad flat file undercuts all incumbents and targets post-acute SaaS vendors (PointClickCare, MatrixCare), SNF staffing agencies, healthcare PE deal teams, and medical supply companies whose primary prospect list is the CMS-certified SNF universe.

audience.who: Post-acute and long-term care SaaS vendors (PointClickCare, MatrixCare, Net Health, Netsmart, Casamba) whose SDRs and AEs cold-call SNF administrators and Directors of Nursing; healthcare staffing agencies placing RNs, LPNs, and CNAs in SNFs who need facility contact + star-rating data to prioritize high-staffing-need accounts; healthcare private equity and M&A advisers screening SNF acquisition targets by size, rating, ownership, and geography; pharmaceutical and medical supply reps (Omnicare, PharMerica, Medline) targeting high-census SNF accounts; and state or national senior care advocacy organizations benchmarking facility quality.

data_wanted: CMS Care Compare — Nursing Home Provider Information dataset, updated monthly. Download URL: https://data.cms.gov/provider-data/dataset/4pq5-n9py. Fields per facility: Federal provider number (CMS Certification Number), provider name, address (street, city, state, ZIP), phone number, county, ownership type (For-profit corporation / Non-profit / Government), ownership organization name, number of certified beds, number of residents (census), overall 5-star rating, health inspection rating, staffing rating, quality measure rating, reported RN staffing hours per resident day, reported LPN staffing hours per resident day, reported CNA staffing hours per resident day, total number of health deficiencies cited, number of fines, total fine amount, most recent standard health inspection date, Medicare/Medicaid participation dates. No login or API key required — direct CSV download from data.cms.gov.

willingness_to_pay.signal: The SNF intelligence market is deeply commercial: Definitive Healthcare runs $15K+/year, HealthcareData.com charges $395 for a basic list, and enterprise SNF SaaS vendors like PointClickCare and MatrixCare have large SDR teams that actively need facility-level prospect lists. A $49 flat file covering all 15,000 CMS-certified SNFs with 5-star ratings, staffing hours, and ownership data is a 98% cost reduction vs. Definitive Healthcare for any buyer who just needs the list — not the analytics platform. Healthcare staffing agencies (a $20B+ sector) are a secondary high-conviction buyer: they need facilities with low CNA staffing hours (i.e., highest need for contract staff), and this CMS data delivers exactly that filter.
